get.description: List the organization's notes, newest first, a page at a time. To read the next page, pass this page's pageInfo.nextCursor as cursor.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by pageInfo; omit it to request the first page.

schema.description: Opaque cursor returned by pageInfo; omit it to request the first page.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Direction to traverse the stable keyset ordering from the supplied cursor.

schema.description: Direction to traverse the stable keyset ordering from the supplied cursor.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items returned in one page. Defaults to 25; larger reads require another cursor.
